## Accessibility Need / Use Case

What problem does this solve, and who does it help? Real-world context is especially useful here (e.g. "when I get a rapid string of notifications, I currently can't tell them apart").

## Proposed Solution

Describe what you'd like to happen. If relevant, note how other screen readers (TalkBack, VoiceOver, NVDA) handle something similar — precedent is helpful.

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative approaches you thought about, and why you prefer this one.

## Scope

- [ ] Small addition (isolated change, low risk)
- [ ] Larger feature (touches multiple modules / needs design discussion first)

## Additional Context

Mockups, sketches, or links to relevant Zepp OS API docs, if any.
